from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
import math

img = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0102.png'))
# Dark brown leg color: R ~ 86, G ~ 43, B ~ 17
leg_mask = (img[:, :, 0] > 70) & (img[:, :, 0] < 100) & (img[:, :, 1] > 30) & (img[:, :, 1] < 60)
ys, xs = np.where(leg_mask)
print(f'Leg rows: min={ys.min()}, max={ys.max()}')

# Left leg and right leg bottom:
left_leg = xs < 200
right_leg = xs >= 200

r_left = ys[left_leg].max()
c_left = xs[left_leg & (ys == r_left)].mean()

r_right = ys[right_leg].max()
c_right = xs[right_leg & (ys == r_right)].mean()

print(f'Left leg base: r={r_left}, c={c_left}')
print(f'Right leg base: r={r_right}, c={c_right}')

f = 256.0; H = 1.55; cx = 255.5; cy = 255.5
xc, yc, head = -0.8855, 4.0158, 270.0
rad = math.radians(head)

def calc(u, v):

    x_c = D * (u - cx) / f
    y_c = D
    xw = xc + y_c * math.sin(rad) + x_c * math.cos(rad)
    yw = yc + y_c * math.cos(rad) - x_c * math.sin(rad)
    return xw, yw, D

p_left = calc(c_left, r_left)
p_right = calc(c_right, r_right)

print(f'Right leg ground: x={p_right[0]:.4f}, y={p_right[1]:.4f}, D={p_right[2]:.4f}')
